top_events.title: Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing
top_events.label: Russia double-tap strike kills 40 in Ukraine village
top_events.summary: Russian forces killed at least 40 civilians in a Ukrainian village with 30 more trapped under rubble. The attack continues the pattern of strikes on civilian areas near Poland's eastern border.

top_events.title: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
top_events.label: Republicans blame Trump for US midterm election loss
top_events.summary: Democrats won control of Congress in US midterms, which Trump attributes to Iran war. The shift may affect future NATO support and security commitments to Poland's region.

top_events.title: French blood storage impacted by freezer hacks as theories swirl about culprits
top_events.label: Cyber-attack hits French blood storage cold rooms
top_events.summary: Hackers targeted French blood storage facilities, part of ongoing coordinated cyber-attacks on EU infrastructure affecting multiple countries including Poland.
